name: urCheckout Lite for WooCommerce
author: monjeur

sections.description:
urCheckout Lite for WooCommerce allows WooCommerce merchants to accept USDC payments directly from customer wallets.
The plugin generates a QR code at checkout for seamless transactions, and funds are deposited instantly to your crypto wallet.

Key features:

  • Accept USDC payments securely and instantly.
  • Lite Version: Supports USDC only.
  • Prime Version: Multi-crypto support – hundreds of ERC-20 tokens supported.
  • Seamless WooCommerce integration – ready to use out-of-the-box.
  • Blockchain monitoring ensures payment verification before order status is updated.
  • Instant payment confirmation, no chargebacks or delays.

urCheckout Lite provides a simple, reliable solution for merchants who want to add crypto payment options to their store.

🎥 Plugin Demo

Try urCheckout live demo here:
https://urcheckout.urlennia.com/shop/

Learn more at https://secure.urlennia.com/urcheckout

Usage

  1. During checkout, the customer selects urCheckout as the payment method.
  2. A QR code and payment instructions appear on the checkout page.
  3. The customer pays using USDC from their wallet.
  4. After the transaction is confirmed on the blockchain, the order status updates to “Processing” and the customer is redirected to the Thank You page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the urCheckout folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → urCheckout.
  4. Configure:
    • Enable urCheckout.
    • Enter your Alchemy API key
    • Enter your merchant wallet address.
  5. Save changes.
sections.faq:
Can I accept other ERC-20 tokens?

The Lite Version only supports USDC. For multi-crypto support, upgrade to Prime.

What happens when the invoice expires?

If the payment is not completed before expiration, the order is automatically cancelled and stock levels are restored.

Is urCheckout secure?

Yes. Payments are handled directly between the customer wallet and the merchant wallet, with blockchain verification for each transaction.
